headline: Norse Atlantic suspends all flights, may file for bankruptcy
pages: Norwegian low-cost carrier Norse Atlantic Airways has suspended all flights while it tries to resolve what it called a critical financial situation. It said it intends to file for bankruptcy if no solution is found. The airline flies 12 Boeing 787 jets on long-haul routes from airports including London Gatwick, Rome and Oslo. The suspension also hit Pakistan International Airlines, which leased aircraft and crews from Norse, and PIA said its UK flights will now use its own fleet. Consumer group Which? advised customers not to cancel, since doing so removes the right to a refund. Norse launched in 2021 and has struggled to turn a profit.
Fuel prices roughly doubled at one point this year because of the Iran war, and Norse does not hedge fuel costs, leaving it fully exposed. Source: BBC.
